title: Hazel and the Bell
author: Quentin Dravenmoor
blurb: Jude Amberdale, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
